description: Linéaire cyclable (en km) is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Le linéaire pour une année donnée correspond au cumul au 1er janvier des itinéraires cyclables sous forme de piste, voie verte, bande, couloir bus ouverts aux vélos, voies et chemins fermés à la circulation générale, voies piétonnes ouvertes aux vélos et doubles sens cyclable simples sur le territoire de la ville de Paris. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are piste cyclable, plan vélo. The portal shows 12 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-05-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
